link.04f098ead5ad.source: Fleet dynamics and containment. What changes when N agents run in parallel: each agent redundantly re-discovers the same context (rediscovery cost), topologies with too many hops lose coherence, and an agent grading a peer's output can shift its verdicts based on social context rather than content. How to bound any single agent in the fleet with kernel-level containment (Landlock, seccomp, network namespaces) when prompt rules and guardrails are not enough to limit blast radius.
link.04f098ead5ad.value: 代理程式群動態與隔離。當 N 個代理程式並行執行階段會發生哪些變化：每個代理程式都會重複發現相同的上下文（重複發現成本）；包含過多跳轉的拓撲會失去連貫性；負責評判同伴輸出的代理程式可能會因社交語境而非內容本身改變結論。當提示詞規則和防護機制不足以限制影響範圍時，如何使用核心級隔離（Landlock、seccomp、網路名稱空間）約束代理程式群中的任一代理程式。

link.ccc6894835d0.source: Self-host with NIM when the model needs to run on-prem or in your VPC. NVIDIA Inference Microservices package the model, tokenizer, and an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server into one container. The Persona, Tooled, and ReAct agents in Modules 1 and 2 can use a compatible NIM endpoint after you verify its model, tool-call, and structured-output support.
link.ccc6894835d0.value: 當模型需要在內部部署環境或您的 VPC 中執行時，可使用 NIM 自行託管。NVIDIA Inference Microservices 將模型、Tokenizer 與相容於 OpenAI 的 HTTP 伺服器封裝在同一個容器中。確認 NIM 端點的模型、工具呼叫及結構化輸出支援後，模組 1 與 2 的 Persona、Tooled 和 ReAct 代理程式便可使用相容的端點。

link.d2d73194e73d.source: NeMo Retriever provides retrieval components beyond Module 2b's in-memory cosine search. Sparse keyword search and dense vector search run in parallel and their scores are merged, a reranker re-orders the candidates by relevance, and configurable chunking primitives let you control how documents are split before indexing. Pair it with NIM-served embeddings and choose where to host the retrieval stack and its data.
link.d2d73194e73d.value: NeMo Retriever 提供模組 2b 記憶體內餘弦搜尋之外的檢索元件。稀疏關鍵字搜尋與稠密向量搜尋會並行執行，再合併分數；重排序器依相關性重新排列候選結果，而可設定的分塊元件讓您控制文件在建立索引前的拆分方式。搭配 NIM 提供的嵌入服務，並選擇檢索技術堆疊與資料的託管位置。

link.d4321e53772d.source: The loop. Module 1 turned a single chat call into an agent by wrapping it in a cycle that calls a tool, feeds the result back, and runs again until the model is done. That cycle is the execution layer, the part a runtime like OpenClaw or a framework like LangGraph gives you so you do not hand-roll it.
link.d4321e53772d.value: 迴圈。模組 1 將一次聊天呼叫轉化為代理程式：在呼叫外加入迴圈，讓模型呼叫工具、接收傳回結果並繼續執行，直至完成任務。這個迴圈就是執行層。OpenClaw 之類的執行階段或 LangGraph 之類的框架會為您提供這一層，無需您自行實現。

link.e7f42df6009a.source: Hermes Agent (Nous Research) and its security guide. A separate agent application with skills from experience, persistent memory, built-in cron, and a messaging gateway; useful when comparing agent applications with the OpenShell security runtime and the NemoClaw reference stack.

link.eae34ea2fe2f.source: Measure the value of additional model calls. Chen et al. (2024) studied repeated-call voting and filtering. On their studied tasks, adding calls could improve results and then reduce them. That finding does not determine the best agent architecture for your task. Measure whether an added call or agent fixes a specific failure and whether its benefit justifies its cost.
link.eae34ea2fe2f.value: 衡量額外模型呼叫的價值。Chen et al. (2024)研究了重複呼叫所得回應的投票與篩選。在其研究的任務上，增加呼叫次數可能先改善結果，再使結果變差。這項發現無法決定哪種代理程式架構最適合您的任務。請衡量增加一次呼叫或一個代理程式是否能修正特定失敗，以及效益是否值得其成本。

link.ec4b25198e90.source: Xu et al. (2025). A-MEM: Atomic Notes for Agent Memory. arXiv:2502.12110.
link.ec4b25198e90.value: Xu et al. (2025)。A-MEM: Atomic Notes for Agent Memory. arXiv:2502.12110。

link.f2da434881fb.source: NeMo Data Curator provides corpus preparation tools such as deduplication and filtering. Evaluate cleanup against your retrieval tasks; it does not guarantee that every answer improves.
link.f2da434881fb.value: NeMo Data Curator 提供去除重複內容和篩選等語料準備工具。請依據檢索任務評估清理效果；清理不保證每個回答都會改善。

rich.0145cbc70971.source: Check administrative authority separately. The read survey in Module 4a tests selected methods with the current token. Write authority depends on its scope and the gateway configuration. Inspect those grants and protect the credential; read success alone does not establish control over the agent.
rich.0145cbc70971.value: 分別檢查管理權限。模組 4a 的讀取檢查使用目前的權杖測試選定方法。寫入權限取決於權杖範圍及閘道組態。請檢查這些權限並保護憑證；讀取成功本身不能證明可控制代理程式。

rich.1a0cf9d2d225.source:
Test application checks and runtime permissions. Requests that pass application checks can still cause harm. Evaluate both the handling of untrusted instructions and the capabilities available to the agent.

Use independent execution controls when a workflow can read sensitive data, change files, or communicate externally. Verify that those controls apply to each execution path.
rich.1a0cf9d2d225.value:
測試應用程式檢查與執行階段權限。通過應用程式檢查的請求仍可能造成傷害。請評估不可信指令的處理方式，以及代理程式可用的能力。

當工作流程可讀取敏感資料、變更檔案或對外通訊時，請使用獨立的執行控制。驗證這些控制是否適用於每條執行路徑。

rich.2bf53715ac78.source: The Course Assistant behind the ✦ button is available on every English lesson. It preloads the current page. When a question crosses modules, the assistant can inspect the course map, search the lessons, and read the relevant pages. Browser-local persistence means sessions stay in this browser: return to one after navigating or reloading, or create another for a clean line of inquiry. As a session grows, the assistant compacts older turns into durable memory, keeps the recent exchange verbatim, and starts a fresh bounded agent thread from that state.
rich.2bf53715ac78.value: ✦ 按鈕開啟的 Course Assistant可在每個英文課程頁面使用，並會預先載入目前頁面。問題跨越多個模組時，助理可以查看課程地圖、搜尋課程內容並讀取相關頁面。工作階段會持久儲存在此瀏覽器中，因此導覽至其他頁面或重新載入後仍可返回原工作階段，也可建立新的工作階段來展開另一項查詢。隨著工作階段增長，助理會將較舊的對話輪次壓縮為持久記憶，逐字保留近期交流，再從該狀態啟動一個有範圍限制的新代理程式執行緒。

rich.5f4e4d0c1702.source: The runtime. Module 3 moved those workflows into OpenClaw, where gateway sessions, workspace files, skills, and schedules persist beyond a browser call.
rich.5f4e4d0c1702.value: 執行階段。模組 3 將這些工作流程遷移到 OpenClaw 中；在那裡，閘道會話、工作區檔案、技能和排程任務都能在一次瀏覽器呼叫結束後繼續保留。

rich.adae57a44156.source: The knowledge layer. Evaluate structural chunking, page-image retrieval, and answer faithfulness on the different kinds of documents in your corpus.
rich.adae57a44156.value: 知識層。針對語料庫中的不同文件類型，評估依結構分塊、頁面影像檢索，以及答案是否忠於來源。

rich.d9a1d134866b.source: Transfer the interface contract, then adapt the environment. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, visible state, and approval controls travel well. Authentication, cross-origin access, persistence, filesystem reach, backend tools, and host UI bridges do not. Keep those dependencies behind narrow adapters so the workflow can move without pretending every host grants the same authority.
rich.d9a1d134866b.value: 遷移介面契約，再適配環境。 HTML、CSS、JavaScript、可見狀態和審批控制元件都易於遷移。身分驗證、跨域存取、持久化、檔案系統存取範圍、後端工具和主機 UI 橋接則不然。請將這些依賴置於精簡的介面卡之後，使工作流程能夠遷移，同時避免假定每種主機都授予相同權限。

rich.e9b653317b4a.source: The substrate. Wire-format protocols (MCP, the Responses API, OTel GenAI conventions, A2A) that keep tool capabilities portable across providers and frameworks.
rich.e9b653317b4a.value: 基礎層。線格式協議（MCP、Responses API、OTel GenAI 約定和 A2A），用於保持工具能力在不同提供商和框架之間的可移植性。

rich.f04e5d4c4cad.source: The workflow. Module 2 compared fixed pipelines, retrieval, and research branches. Evaluate context selection and prompt wording against the same task and evidence.
rich.f04e5d4c4cad.value: 工作流程。模組 2 比較了固定管線、檢索和研究分支。請以相同的任務和證據，評估上下文選擇及提示詞措辭。

rich.f575eb724c92.source: The containment. Module 4 examined restrictions on files, network access, and process operations. Their effect depends on active policy and enforcement; harmful use of allowed capabilities remains possible.
rich.f575eb724c92.value: 隔離限制。模組 4 檢視了檔案、網路存取和程序操作的限制。效果取決於目前生效的策略及其執行情況；獲准的能力仍可能遭到有害使用。

text.080cfa07af21.source: This course. The containment work from Modules 3 and 4: deny-by-default network, Landlock filesystem, seccomp hardening, credential isolation, and continuous safety evaluation on a long-running claw.
text.080cfa07af21.value: 即本課程。內容涵蓋模組 3 和模組 4 中的隔離實踐：預設拒絕網路存取、Landlock 檔案系統、seccomp 加固、憑證隔離，以及針對長期執行的 claw 持續開展安全評測。

text.0993d1cc5c1b.source: The planner, sub-agent delegation, and virtual-filesystem memory you hand-rolled in Module 2c, built here with LangChain's deepagents library and the NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint.
